properties.name: inputMode
properties.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

properties.name: is
properties.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

properties.name: autoWidth
properties.description: 自适应宽度配置，优先级低于widthSize属性，selfAdaptive表示单个按钮根据内部文字自适应，groupAdaptive表示单个按钮根据同组按钮宽度自适应

properties.name: heightSize
properties.description: 高度配置：默认是32px的高度，支持在空间有限情况下选在28px的small宽度

properties.name: textLineType
properties.description: 类型配置：配置单行文本模式或双行文本模式

properties.name: iconLayout
properties.description: 支持将icon放置在文本的右侧

properties.name: horizontalLayout
properties.description: 支持配置水平布局。在有icon时，icon和文字默认一起居中布局，通过配置为stretch后可以左右伸展对齐。

properties.name: checkedStyle
properties.description: radio选中样式 (来自存储设计规范)

properties.name: radioProps
properties.description: 透传radio的样式props，可以直接在Group中配置Radio的样式等属性

properties.name: type
properties.description: 单选的类型，是单选还是按钮

properties.name: size
properties.description: 按钮类型的单选框尺寸（只在按钮类型下生效）

doclets.name: GroupOption
